evidence.runtime-browser: pass: native Bold command toggles aria-pressed and application-owned status in the real consumer
evidence.accessibility: pass: toolbar/group roles, native buttons, accessible command names, pressed state, disabled state and scoped axe scan are browser-checked
evidence.focused-visual: pass: focused pressed consumer toolbar snapshot covers focus-visible and selected paint
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: Data Workspace supplies the command controller and selection state outside the library
